newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian Air H1 profit swoops into black.
newsitem.headline: Austrian Air H1 profit swoops into black.

text.p: Austrian Airlines announced on Tuesday a huge turnaround in first half results, with pre-tax profit hitting 7.8 million schillings after a loss of 313 million in the year-ago period.
Revenue rose 13.1 percent to 6.51 billion schillings, the airline said in a statement.
The airline said it was the first set of positive earnings at the interim period since 1990.
AUA carried a total 1,741,173 passengers on scheduled and charter flights in the first half, up 11.1 percent on the year-ago period.
Passenger numbers on scheduled flights climbed 8.9 percent to 1,480,658, while charter flight passengers jumped 25.5 percent to 260,515.
Air cargo was up 2.5 percent at 30,846 tonnes and cargo revenue up 12.5 percent.
Austria's flagship carrier said it managed to improve its passenger load factor by 6.6 percentage points to 61.6 percent.
